definitions.gloss: very interested; full of curiosity; with keen interest
definitions.explanation: Describes a state of being deeply curious or fascinated by something. A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) where {津々|しんしん} means 'overflowing' or 'welling up,' so the literal sense is 'interest overflowing.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{興味津々|きょうみしんしん}だった。
examples.english: The children were full of curiosity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{興味津々|きょうみしんしん}な⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いていた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: She was listening to the story with a look of keen interest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{外国|がいこく}→外国：02868_gaikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧{興味津々|きょうみしんしん}で⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらなかった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone was so curious about the foreign food they were seeing for the first time that the questions wouldn't stop.

notes:
A ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character compound). {津々|しんしん} means 'overflowing' or 'welling up endlessly,' so the expression literally conveys interest that keeps bubbling up.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {興味津々|きょうみしんしん}な⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧ — a look of keen interest
- {興味津々|きょうみしんしん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ — to watch with great curiosity
- {興味津々|きょうみしんしん}な⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧ — an air of fascination

USAGE:
Can function as a な-adjective ({興味津々|きょうみしんしん}な), a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective ({興味津々|きょうみしんしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧), or a たる-adjective ({興味津々|きょうみしんしん}たる), though the な form is most common in modern usage. Also used as a predicate with だ: {興味津々|きょうみしんしん}だ (to be very interested).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{好奇心旺盛|こうきしんおうせい}→好奇心旺盛：30387_koukishinousei⟧ — insatiably curious (describes a personality trait, while {興味津々|きょうみしんしん} describes a momentary state)
- ⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ — to be interested (neutral, less emphatic)
